Coram : RAJENDRA MAL LODHA*, ANIL R. DAVE
UTTAR PRADESH LAND REVENUE ACT, 1901: A B s. 219 - Revision before Board of Revenue in 1994 after c dismissal of revision uls 218, held by High Court as not maintainable - Held: There was no provision in s.219 prior to amendment in 1997, to bar the revision filed by appellant ul s 219 - The application before Board of Revenue 0 under the then existing s.219 - Order of High Court set aside and writ petition of appellant before it restored for hearing on merits. The respondents filed an appeal u/s 210 of the Uttar Pradesh Land Revenue Act, 1901 before the Sub- E Divisional Officer,
Decision Date : 03-09-2012 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 6247/2012 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
